_source:
A real 'Fashion and Fabrics Form 2 Scheme of Work' (a real Zambian secondary school's department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive, across separate Term 1 and Term 2 documents. This is a genuine gap fill — this app previously had no Fashion and Fabrics Form 2 content at all (only Form 1). Cites the real official '2024 Fashion and Fabrics Syllabus Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' with real page citations (Term 1: pg. 28-31; Term 2: pg. 31-34).

Only Term 1 and Term 2 source material was found in the Drive folder for this subject at Form 2 — no Term 3 document exists there. This is a genuine, honestly-disclosed gap, not a fabrication: Term 3 is simply not included in this file.

Each term document's own 'MID-TERM TESTS' and 'END OF TERM TESTS' weeks are excluded, since they name no new specific competences. Term 2's closing three weeks ('Revision of All Term 2 Topics' and the two-week 'Practical Project / Application of Skills') are also excluded — they carry no real topic/sub-topic number of their own (unlike, e.g., 2.11 or 2.12) and consist of recap and a capstone project applying previously-learned skills rather than naming new content.

A real structural feature of the source scheme, preserved rather than 'corrected': Topic 2.8 'Construction Processes' genuinely spans both terms — its first sub-topic (2.8.1 Crossway Strips) falls in the last week of Term 1, while its remaining four sub-topics (2.8.2 Openings, 2.8.3 Fastenings, 2.8.4 Neckline Finishes, 2.8.5 Armhole Finishes) open Term 2. This file represents Topic 2.8 twice, once per term, with only the sub-topics that term's own document actually covers under it.

Content/Concept column text is summarised into each sub-topic's own description; the scheme's own Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

subject.name: Fashion and Fabrics
subject.description: Fashion and Fabrics syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: 2.1 Safety and Environmental Impact of Textile Production

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1 Environmental Impact of Textile Production
sub_topics.description: Environmental issues in textile production; sustainable practices; upcycling old clothing into new items.

competencies.description: Employ sustainable practices that can help mitigate environmental impacts of textile production

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 Cosmetology in the Fashion Industry
sub_topics.description: Relationship between cosmetology and fashion; basic hair and facial makeup techniques.

competencies.description: Apply techniques of hair and facial makeup

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 Millinery
sub_topics.description: Importance of millinery; headwear-making techniques and materials.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.1 The Sewing Machine
sub_topics.description: Sewing stitches; common sewing machine faults and their correction.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.1 Production of Yarns and Fabrics
sub_topics.description: Stages of yarn production from natural fibres; texture, thickness, colour.

sub_topics.name: 2.6.1 Colour Combination
sub_topics.description: Colour combinations; dyeing and printing on fabric.

competencies.description: Create different desired artwork on fabric

sub_topics.name: 2.7.1 Forms of Design
sub_topics.description: Fashion versus interior design; practical application of forms of interior design.

sub_topics.name: 2.7.2 Principles of Design
sub_topics.description: Principles of design (balance, harmony, emphasis) and their practical application.

sub_topics.name: 2.7.3 Culture and Design
sub_topics.description: Cultural costumes, norms and values; how culture influences the design process.

competencies.description: Show culture into the design processes

topics.name: 2.8 Construction Processes
topics.description: This topic spans Term 1 and Term 2 in the real source scheme; this term's document covers only its first sub-topic (2.8.2-2.8.5 continue in Term 2).

sub_topics.name: 2.8.1 Crossway Strips
sub_topics.description: Definition and uses of crossway strips; cutting and joining a crossway strip to finish off articles.

topics.name: 2.8 Construction Processes
topics.description: This topic spans Term 1 and Term 2 in the real source scheme; this term's document continues from Term 1's 2.8.1 with these remaining sub-topics.

sub_topics.name: 2.8.2 Openings
sub_topics.description: Types of openings and classes; practical application of working out different openings.

sub_topics.name: 2.8.3 Fastenings
sub_topics.description: Types of fastenings; factors to consider; attaching a zip, button and loop.

sub_topics.name: 2.8.4 Neckline Finishes
sub_topics.description: Types of neckline finishes: binding, facing, piping.

sub_topics.name: 2.8.5 Armhole Finishes
sub_topics.description: Methods of armhole finishing: binding, facing, sleeve; reasons for finishing.

sub_topics.name: 2.9.1 Basketry
sub_topics.description: Materials and techniques for basketry: coiling, twining, plaiting.

sub_topics.name: 2.10.1 Care and Maintenance of Clothes
sub_topics.description: Importance of care; characteristics of fabrics; care labels; practising using eco-friendly detergents.

sub_topics.name: 2.11.1 Consumer Rights and Responsibilities
sub_topics.description: Consumer rights; sources of consumer education; methods of redress.

sub_topics.name: 2.12.1 Entrepreneurial Projects in Fashion and Fabrics
sub_topics.description: Business opportunities; project development, from developing a simple business idea to undertaking it.

competencies.description: Develop various projects in fashion and fabric
